role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 修补匠运用众多致命的器具摧毁敌人。如果他能集齐所需的资源，瞬间刷新技能的力量可以让他在各大前线引领着他的团队。
hero_summary_en: Tinker demolishes foes with swarms of machines and a host of deadly gadgets. If he can gather the resources he needs, the power that instantly refreshes his abilities enables him to lead his team from every front.

abilities.name: tinker_laser
abilities.description_zh: 发射强烈的能量光束，对目标造成伤害和致盲。被致盲的单位，所有物理攻击都会落空。
abilities.description_en: Fires an intense energy beam, damaging and blinding the target. Blinded targets miss all physical attacks.

scepter_loc.en: Upgrades Tinker's Laser into a Shrink Ray, reducing the main target's size, current health, and maximum health by %scepter_reduction_pct%%% (stacking). Does not pierce debuff immunity.
scepter_loc.zh: 修补匠的激光升级成缩小射线，使主目标的模型大小、当前生命值和最大生命值减少%scepter_reduction_pct%%%（可以叠加）。

abilities.name: tinker_march_of_the_machines
abilities.description_zh: 征募一支机器人军队，摧毁修补匠周围的敌方单位。
abilities.description_en: Enlists an army of robotic minions to destroy enemy units in an area around Tinker.
notes_zh: 机器人的产生速率是每秒%machines_per_sec%个。
notes_en: Robots spawn at a rate of %machines_per_sec% per second.

scepter_loc.en: March of the Machines applies a non-stacking heal over time when passing through allied heroes.
scepter_loc.zh: 机械行军在穿过友方英雄时会施加不可叠加的持续治疗效果。

facet_text_en: March of the Machines applies a non-stacking heal over time when passing through allied heroes.
facet_text_zh: 机械行军在穿过友方英雄时会施加不可叠加的持续治疗效果。

abilities.name: tinker_deploy_turrets
abilities.description_zh: 在目标地点部署3个不可控的炮塔。被炮塔撞击的敌人受到伤害，并向远离落地点的方向推去。如果修补匠被撞击，他也会被推走。部署完毕后，炮塔开始向最近敌方英雄的方向发射导弹。
abilities.description_en: Deploys 3 uncontrollable turrets at the target location. Enemies hit by the impact take damage and are pushed away from the landing point. If Tinker is hit, he also gets pushed by the impact. Once deployed, the turret fires missiles in the direction of the nearest enemy hero.

abilities.name: tinker_warp_grenade
abilities.description_zh: 向一个敌人扔出一枚光弹，造成伤害，将其向远离修补匠的方向传送并且缠绕，同时降低施法和攻击距离，持续%debuff_duration%秒。目标距离修补匠越近，传送距离越大。
abilities.description_en: Throws a flare towards an enemy, dealing damage, teleporting them away, rooting them and reducing their Cast and Attack Range for %debuff_duration% seconds.The target is teleported further the closer they are to Tinker.
notes_zh: 最大传送距离为%warp_distance_pct_tooltip%%%折跃耀光施法距离，在最大施法距离时降至0。
notes_en: Max teleportation distance is %warp_distance_pct_tooltip%%% of Warp Flare's cast range, which decreases down to 0 at max cast range.

abilities.name: tinker_rearm
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 重置修补匠技能的冷却时间。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Resets the cooldown on Tinker's abilities.

abilities.name: tinker_eureka
abilities.description_zh: 修补匠的每%int_per_one_cdr%点智力提供%one_percent_tooltip%%%物品冷却时间减少，最多为%max_cdr%%%。
abilities.description_en: Tinker gains %one_percent_tooltip%%% item cooldown reduction per %int_per_one_cdr% Intelligence, up to a maximum of %max_cdr%%%.
